subject.title: Morgan Hill Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: I am running for the Morgan Hill Unified School Board to ensure every student has access to safe, supportive schools and a high-quality education that prepares them for college, and/or a career, and life.

For more than 25 years, I have worked in technology, business development, public policy, and education advocacy. I bring experience managing budgets, building partnerships, and delivering results with accountability.

Education is personal to me. My wife has taught in public schools for 20+ years, and our sons attended Morgan Hill schools. As a classroom volunteer and member of the Sobrato High School Site Council, I have seen firsthand the value of how strong collaboration between parents, educators, and staff improves student outcomes.

As your trustee, I will focus on strong academics, transparent budgeting, and ensuring resources reach classrooms. I am proud to be endorsed by the Morgan Hill Federation of Teachers for my commitment to attracting and retaining excellent teachers, expanding college and career pathways, and strengthening investment in special education and student support services.
Building Better Schools Together means listening, partnering with all education stakeholders and keeping students at the center of every decision. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Ten years ago, I moved to Area 3, drawn by its diversity and strong sense of community. When it was time to enroll my oldest child in school, I was encouraged to look outside our neighborhood. Instead, I chose our neighborhood public school, P.A. Walsh.
That decision changed the direction of my life.

I became involved in my children's school and began advocating for students and families across our district. As your appointed Area 3 Trustee, I have brought my community experience, a Social Justice degree from Gavilan College, and my ongoing social work training at San José State to every decision on the board.

I believe public schools are one of our most powerful institutions for creating opportunity. Our students have diverse backgrounds and diverse needs, and academic success requires supporting the whole child, because children cannot learn when their basic needs go unmet.

I was appointed to the board two years ago to represent Area 3 in support of our students, educators, and public schools. I am running to continue building inclusive, welcoming schools where every child is supported, where every family belongs, and where every student has the opportunity to thrive.
